semiconductor_relevance: Low — Taiwan Fylin Industrial primarily focuses on sheet metal fabrications and transport tooling rather than semiconductor-specific products or services.
summary: Taiwan Fylin Industrial Co., Ltd. specializes in precision sheet metal fabrication and customized transport tooling, particularly for Unit Load Devices (ULDs) used in the air cargo industry. They provide integration services for metal processing and manufacture enclosures for various applications, including medical and aerospace.
capabilities: Customized metal enclosures for medical and industrial applications
Precision sheet metal fabrication including laser cutting and CNC processing
Design support for transport tooling solutions
Manufacturing of Unit Load Devices compliant with NAS3610 and IATA regulations

regional_presence.Taiwan: TFI is based in Taiwan and is the largest ULD specialist in the region, with advanced manufacturing facilities.
